Reject: a `gate (live …)` row whose instrument has no self-test mode and no declared differential; a Self-test cell that enumerates a fixture count the counter does not run; a row whose Kind label and Self-test cell contradict each other; silently deleting a red row instead of demoting or re-pinning it.
